blocks.zh: 附錄一至三：職責分工、風險評估與確認交付物
blocks.en: Appendices 1 to 3: Roles and Responsibilities, Risk Assessment and Qualification Deliverables

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 IT 基礎架構中各角色（Platform Owner、Application Owner、IT Quality & Compliance、Independent QA）的職責邊界
blocks.en: Understand the responsibility boundaries of each role in IT infrastructure (Platform Owner, Application Owner, IT Quality & Compliance, Independent QA)

blocks.zh: 掌握「所有權不可外包」原則——受監管公司永遠保有 QA 最終責任
blocks.en: Grasp the principle that "ownership cannot be outsourced": the regulated company always retains final responsibility for QA

blocks.zh: 學習 GAMP 兩階段風險評估方法：Stage 1（可能性 × 衝擊）→ Stage 2（偵測概率）→ 風險優先級
blocks.en: Learn the GAMP two-stage risk assessment method: Stage 1 (likelihood × impact) → Stage 2 (probability of detection) → risk priority

blocks.zh: 了解 Type 與 Instance 資格確認的概念差異，以及 Table A3.1 各角色在各交付物的參與方式
blocks.en: Understand the conceptual difference between Type and Instance qualification, and how each role takes part in each deliverable in Table A3.1

blocks.zh: Appendix 1 — Roles and Responsibilities 職責分工
blocks.en: Appendix 1 — Roles and Responsibilities

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「Owner」的意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: What "Owner" Means

blocks.zh: Owner（負責人）不只是頭銜，更是一種業務問責。指南特別強調：真正的 ownership 只能由「其業務目標直接依賴該系統可用性與效能」的人承擔。
blocks.en: An Owner is not just a job title but a form of business accountability. The guide stresses that real ownership can only be held by someone whose business objectives depend directly on the availability and performance of the system.

blocks.zh: 換言之，Owner 必須是使用者，不是 IT 維運人員。若系統停擺會直接衝擊他的業務 KPI，他才有動機負責。
blocks.en: In other words, the Owner must be a user, not an IT operations person. Only if a system outage directly hits their business KPIs do they have the motivation to take responsibility.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 就像工廠生產線的線長（Line Leader）：他不一定最懂機器原理，但機器停了他最心急——因為產量是他的責任。IT 系統的 Owner 應該是同樣心態的人，而不是「幫別人保管系統」的 IT 工程師。
blocks.en: Think of the line leader on a factory production line. They may not understand the machines best, but they are the most anxious when a machine stops, because output is their responsibility. The Owner of an IT system should have the same mindset, rather than being an IT engineer who merely "looks after the system for someone else".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：8 大角色要記住
blocks.en: Key Point: Remember the 8 Roles

blocks.zh: GAMP IT 指南定義了 8 個關鍵角色。在 CDMO 中，這 8 個角色不一定對應 8 個人——一個人可能身兼多職，但每個角色的職責邊界必須書面化（Job Description + 簽名）。
blocks.en: The GAMP IT guide defines 8 key roles. In a CDMO these 8 roles do not necessarily map to 8 people, since one person may hold several roles, but the responsibility boundaries of each role must be documented (job description + signature).

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: 在您的組織中，LIMS 系統的「Application Owner」是哪個部門？IT 還是 QC？為什麼？
blocks.en: In your organization, which department is the Application Owner of the LIMS: IT or QC? Why?

blocks.zh: 若一個人同時是 Platform Owner 和 Data Owner，這樣的安排是否有利益衝突風險？如何緩解？
blocks.en: If one person is both Platform Owner and Data Owner, does this arrangement create a risk of conflict of interest? How can it be mitigated?

blocks.zh: §2 Executive Management & §3 Project Manager §2 高階管理 & §3 專案經理
blocks.en: §2 Executive Management & §3 Project Manager

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「不可外包的原則」
blocks.en: Key Point: The "Non-Outsourcing Principle"

blocks.zh: 這是整個 Appendix 1 最重要的句子：「系統與資料的 Ownership 和 QA 不可外包。」
blocks.en: This is the most important sentence in Appendix 1: "Ownership and QA of systems and data cannot be outsourced."

blocks.zh: 即使你把整個 IT 基礎架構委外給 AWS 或外部 IT 廠商，受監管公司仍然：
blocks.en: Even if you outsource your entire IT infrastructure to AWS or an external IT vendor, the regulated company still:

blocks.zh: 保有 qualification status 的責任
blocks.en: retains responsibility for the qualification status

blocks.zh: 必須設定 SLA 期望值並監控執行
blocks.en: must set SLA expectations and monitor performance against them

blocks.zh: 不能將 QA 最終判斷外包給廠商
blocks.en: cannot outsource the final QA judgment to the vendor

blocks.zh: 就像藥廠委外生產（CMO）：成品的 QP 放行責任仍在製造授權持有人（MAH）身上，不在 CMO。IT 也是同理——即使系統跑在 Azure 雲上，GxP compliance 的負責人仍是藥廠自己。
blocks.en: It is like contract manufacturing (CMO): responsibility for QP release of the finished product stays with the marketing authorization holder (MAH), not the CMO. The same applies to IT: even if the system runs on the Azure cloud, the party responsible for GxP compliance is still the pharmaceutical company itself.

blocks.zh: Project Manager vs. Platform Owner：轉移時機
blocks.en: Project Manager vs. Platform Owner: When Responsibility Transfers

blocks.zh: Project Manager（專案經理）：在專案期間負責協調；專案完成後「交棒」給 Platform Owner 進行日常維運。
blocks.en: Project Manager: coordinates during the project; once the project is complete, hands over to the Platform Owner for day-to-day operation.

blocks.zh: 指南強調「順暢的交接」是 PM 最重要的收尾目標之一——文件必須完整，才能讓 PO 接手後繼續維持 compliance。
blocks.en: The guide stresses that a smooth handover is one of the Project Manager's most important closing goals: the documentation must be complete so that the PO can keep the platform compliant after taking over.

blocks.zh: 您的公司使用 AWS 或 Azure 作為 IT 基礎架構，當稽核員問「誰負責 qualification？」時，您應如何回答？
blocks.en: Your company uses AWS or Azure as its IT infrastructure. When an auditor asks "Who is responsible for qualification?", how should you answer?

blocks.zh: IT 基礎架構專案的 PM，是否需要具備 GxP 知識？為什麼？
blocks.en: Does the PM of an IT infrastructure project need GxP knowledge? Why?

blocks.zh: §4 Application Owner & §5 Data Owner §4 應用程式擁有者 & §5 資料擁有者
blocks.en: §4 Application Owner & §5 Data Owner

blocks.zh: 三個「Owner」的區別
blocks.en: The Difference Between the Three "Owners"

blocks.zh: Application Owner（應用系統負責人）：對整個應用系統負責，包含其所依賴的 IT 基礎架構。他向 Platform Owner 提出平台需求。
blocks.en: Application Owner: responsible for the whole application, including the IT infrastructure it depends on. They raise platform requirements with the Platform Owner.

blocks.zh: Data Owner（資料負責人）：當資料的邏輯歸屬與系統管理者不同時，另立資料負責人。例如：共用檔案伺服器的各部門資料，Application Owner 是 IT，但每個部門才是自己資料的 Data Owner。
blocks.en: Data Owner: a separate Data Owner is appointed when the logical ownership of the data differs from the system administrator. For example, for departmental data on a shared file server, the Application Owner is IT, but each department is the Data Owner of its own data.

blocks.zh: Platform Owner（平台負責人）：管理底層平台（伺服器、網路、客戶端）。
blocks.en: Platform Owner: manages the underlying platforms (servers, networks, clients).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：大樓 vs. 租戶
blocks.en: Analogy: Building vs. Tenants

blocks.zh:
想像一棟辦公大樓：
Platform Owner = 大樓管理員（負責電梯、電力、空調）
Application Owner = 各樓層租戶（負責辦公室裡的業務系統）
Data Owner = 租戶的重要文件夾主人（負責自己的資料安全）
blocks.en:
Imagine an office building:
Platform Owner = building manager (responsible for lifts, power, air conditioning)
Application Owner = tenant on each floor (responsible for the business systems in their office)
Data Owner = owner of the tenant's important files (responsible for the security of their own data)

blocks.zh: 大樓出了問題，租戶提需求給管理員；但租戶自己文件的保管，是自己的責任。
blocks.en: When something goes wrong with the building, tenants submit requests to the manager; but looking after the tenants' own files is their own responsibility.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Data Integrity 的關鍵
blocks.en: Key Point: The Key to Data Integrity

blocks.zh: Data Owner 必須確保的 5 項核心：備份還原、歸檔、變更管理與稽核軌跡、存取限制、可用性——這與 FDA 21 CFR Part 11 的 ALCOA+ 原則高度對應。在 GxP 環境中，Data Integrity 是監管稽查最常被挑戰的點。
blocks.en: The Data Owner must ensure 5 core items: backup and restore, archiving, change management and audit trail, access restriction, and availability. These map closely to the ALCOA+ principles and FDA 21 CFR Part 11. In a GxP environment, data integrity is the point most often challenged in regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: 在您的 CDMO，LIMS 的 Application Owner 和 Data Owner 應該是同一人嗎？
blocks.en: In your CDMO, should the Application Owner and the Data Owner of the LIMS be the same person?

blocks.zh: 如果備份系統故障導致 GxP 資料遺失，誰最終需要對監管機構負責？
blocks.en: If a backup system failure causes GxP data to be lost, who is ultimately accountable to the regulator?

blocks.zh: §6 Infrastructure Process Owner & §7 Platform Owner §6 基礎設施流程擁有者 & §7 平台擁有者
blocks.en: §6 Infrastructure Process Owner & §7 Platform Owner

blocks.zh: Platform Owner 在 CDMO 的實際角色
blocks.en: The Practical Role of the Platform Owner in a CDMO

blocks.zh: Platform Owner（平台負責人）是 IT 基礎架構的核心技術角色，通常分成四類平台：
blocks.en: The Platform Owner is the core technical role in IT infrastructure and usually covers four types of platform:

blocks.zh: Clients（桌電、筆電、工作站）
blocks.en: Clients (desktops, laptops, workstations)

blocks.zh: Servers（應用伺服器、資料庫伺服器）
blocks.en: Servers (application servers, database servers)

blocks.zh: Networks（區域網路、防火牆、VPN）
blocks.en: Networks (LAN, firewalls, VPN)

blocks.zh: Hardware/Peripherals（印表機、標籤機、儀器介面）
blocks.en: Hardware/Peripherals (printers, label printers, instrument interfaces)

blocks.zh: 每類平台可能有各自的 PO，也可能一人管多類——規模決定分工。
blocks.en: Each type of platform may have its own PO, or one person may manage several types; the size of the organization determines the split.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：向稽查員說明的準備
blocks.en: Key Point: Preparing to Explain to Inspectors

blocks.zh: Platform Owner 最後一條職責很重要：「向 QA 和監管機構呈現平台文件，並為所有重要決策提出正當理由。」
blocks.en: The last responsibility of the Platform Owner is an important one: "Present platform documentation to QA and regulators, and justify all significant decisions."

blocks.zh: 這意味著 PO 必須能在稽查時上場回答技術問題，不能只說「這是 IT 的事」。在 CDMO，IT 人員需要具備基本 GxP 素養。
blocks.en: This means the PO must be able to step up during an inspection and answer technical questions, and cannot just say "that is an IT matter". In a CDMO, IT staff need a basic level of GxP literacy.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Infrastructure Process Owner vs. Platform Owner
blocks.en: Analogy: Infrastructure Process Owner vs. Platform Owner

blocks.zh:
Process Owner = 「制定維修 SOP 的工務主管」
Platform Owner = 「負責某類設備（如空調系統）的技術工程師」
兩個角色有時重疊（同一人），有時分開——但 SOP 必須清楚界定各自的職責範圍。
blocks.en:
Process Owner = "the facilities manager who writes the maintenance SOP"
Platform Owner = "the technical engineer responsible for a type of equipment (such as the HVAC system)"
The two roles sometimes overlap (the same person) and sometimes are separate, but the SOP must clearly define each one's scope of responsibility.

blocks.zh: 您公司的 IT 工程師，是否被訓練過「如何在稽查時回答問題」？這是誰的責任？
blocks.en: Have the IT engineers in your company been trained in "how to answer questions during an inspection"? Whose responsibility is this?

blocks.zh: Security patch 的安裝屬於 Platform Owner 的職責，但它可能影響 GxP 應用系統——誰有最終決定權？
blocks.en: Installing security patches is a Platform Owner responsibility, but it may affect GxP applications. Who has the final say?

blocks.zh: §8 Independent QA & §9 IT Quality and Compliance §8 獨立 QA & §9 IT 品質與法規遵循
blocks.en: §8 Independent QA & §9 IT Quality and Compliance

blocks.zh: 兩個 QA 角色的關鍵差異
blocks.en: The Key Difference Between the Two QA Roles

blocks.zh: Independent QA（獨立品保）：對 IT 保持獨立，是最終監管判斷者。有最高 sign-off 權力，負責主持法規稽查。
blocks.en: Independent QA: independent of IT and the final regulatory decision-maker. Holds the highest sign-off authority and leads regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: IT Quality & Compliance（IT 合規）：深嵌在 IT 組織中，具備技術深度，是 QA 和 IT 之間的橋樑。他們不能取代 QA 的最終判斷，但可代為執行許多日常合規工作。
blocks.en: IT Quality & Compliance: embedded in the IT organization with technical depth, acting as the bridge between QA and IT. They cannot replace QA's final judgment, but they can carry out much of the routine compliance work on QA's behalf.

blocks.zh: 兩者職責的邊界必須書面化（關鍵原則）。
blocks.en: The boundary between the two roles must be documented (a key principle).

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院的質量管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Quality Management in a Hospital

blocks.zh:
Independent QA = 醫院的醫療品質委員會（外部視角，有最終否決權）
IT Quality & Compliance = 各科室的品管護士（日常操作，熟悉技術細節，向委員會匯報）

科室品管護士不能批准違反醫療規範的操作，這需要委員會——但委員會不可能盯著每個細節，所以需要科室品管護士作為第一道防線。
blocks.en:
Independent QA = the hospital's medical quality committee (external perspective, final power of veto)
IT Quality & Compliance = the quality nurses in each ward (day-to-day operations, familiar with technical details, reporting to the committee)

A ward quality nurse cannot approve an action that violates medical standards; that requires the committee. But the committee cannot watch every detail, so the ward quality nurses serve as the first line of defense.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 常見缺失
blocks.en: Key Point: Common CDMO Gaps

blocks.zh: 許多中小型 CDMO 沒有設置專門的 IT Quality & Compliance 角色——這等於讓普通 IT 工程師直接面對 QA，但工程師通常不懂 GxP 框架。結果：
blocks.en: Many small and mid-sized CDMOs have no dedicated IT Quality & Compliance role. This leaves ordinary IT engineers dealing directly with QA, yet engineers usually do not understand the GxP framework. The results:

blocks.zh: 變更管理不完整（缺乏合規評估）
blocks.en: Change management is incomplete (no compliance assessment)

blocks.zh: 稽查時 IT 人員答不出來
blocks.en: IT staff cannot answer questions during inspections

blocks.zh: QA 無法有效監督 IT 活動
blocks.en: QA cannot effectively oversee IT activities

blocks.zh: 建立這個橋樑角色，是 IT compliance 成熟度的重要指標。
blocks.en: Establishing this bridging role is an important indicator of IT compliance maturity.

blocks.zh: 在您的組織，IT 與 QA 之間是否有正式的合規橋樑角色？若無，誰在扮演這個功能？
blocks.en: In your organization, is there a formal compliance bridging role between IT and QA? If not, who performs this function?

blocks.zh: 「delegation of activities should be documented」——您的公司是否有文件化 QA 和 IT Q&C 之間的職責分工？
blocks.en: "Delegation of activities should be documented": has your company documented the division of responsibilities between QA and IT Q&C?

blocks.zh: Appendix 2 — Example of Risk Assessment and Controls 風險評估範例
blocks.en: Appendix 2 — Example of Risk Assessment and Controls

blocks.zh: GAMP 兩階段風險評估框架
blocks.en: The GAMP Two-Stage Risk Assessment Framework

blocks.zh: Stage 1（風險水平）：
blocks.en: Stage 1 (risk level):

blocks.zh: 將「發生可能性（Likelihood）」× 「衝擊程度（Impact）」組合，產出 Level 1/2/3 的風險分類。
blocks.en: Combine likelihood × impact to produce a Level 1/2/3 risk classification.

blocks.zh: Stage 2（風險優先級）：
blocks.en: Stage 2 (risk priority):

blocks.zh: 在 Stage 1 結果的基礎上，加入「偵測概率（Probability of Detection）」——若傷害很早就能被偵測到，風險優先級可以降低；若難以偵測，優先級提升。
blocks.en: Building on the Stage 1 result, add the probability of detection. If harm can be detected very early, the risk priority can be lowered; if it is hard to detect, the priority rises.

blocks.zh: 風險評估邏輯（概念式）
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Logic (Conceptual)

blocks.zh:
Stage 1:
  Likelihood (高/中/低) × Impact (高/中/低)
  → Risk Level: 1 (低) / 2 (中) / 3 (高)

Stage 2:
  Risk Level + Detection Probability (高/中/低)
  → Risk Priority: 高優先 / 中優先 / 低優先

風險優先級高 → 需要更嚴格的 Control 措施
風險優先級低 → 可接受現有 Control 或監控即可
blocks.en:
Stage 1:
  Likelihood (high/medium/low) × Impact (high/medium/low)
  → Risk Level: 1 (low) / 2 (medium) / 3 (high)

Stage 2:
  Risk Level + Detection Probability (high/medium/low)
  → Risk Priority: high priority / medium priority / low priority

High risk priority → stricter control measures needed
Low risk priority → existing controls or monitoring may be acceptable

blocks.zh: 比喻：工廠火災風險
blocks.en: Analogy: Factory Fire Risk

blocks.zh:
Stage 1：工廠附近有化學品（高衝擊）× 員工操作不熟練（中可能性）→ Risk Level 2
Stage 2：是否有火災感測器（Detection）？若有完善感測器 → 優先級下降；若感測器老舊 → 優先級維持高
blocks.en:
Stage 1: chemicals stored near the factory (high impact) × staff not skilled in handling them (medium likelihood) → Risk Level 2
Stage 2: are there fire sensors (detection)? With good sensors, the priority goes down; with old sensors, the priority stays high

blocks.zh: IT 安全的邏輯相同：防火牆設定錯誤（高衝擊），加上是否有日誌監控（Detection）來決定最終優先級。
blocks.en: IT security follows the same logic: a misconfigured firewall (high impact), combined with whether log monitoring exists (detection), determines the final priority.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：主觀性與人員素質
blocks.en: Key Point: Subjectivity and the Quality of Personnel

blocks.zh: 指南明確承認：「輸入此步驟的資料大多是主觀的，因為通常缺乏定量數據支撐評估。」這就是為什麼參與風險評估的人員素質至關重要——必須是有均衡技術背景和經驗的人員，而非單純的 IT 工程師或單純的 QA。
blocks.en: The guide explicitly acknowledges that "the data input to this step is mostly subjective, as there is typically a lack of quantitative data to support the assessment." This is why the quality of the people involved in the risk assessment is critical: they must have a balanced technical background and experience, rather than being purely IT engineers or purely QA.

blocks.zh: §3 Risk Evaluation & Table A2.1 — Example Risk Assessment §3 風險評估 & Table A2.1 — 風險評估範例
blocks.en: §3 Risk Evaluation & Table A2.1 — Example Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 重點提示：風險評估是迭代的
blocks.en: Key Point: Risk Assessment Is Iterative

blocks.zh: 指南明確說「風險評估通常是反覆進行的過程」——這不是一次性活動。每當：
blocks.en: The guide states that "risk assessment is usually an iterative process", so it is not a one-off activity. The risk assessment should be repeated whenever:

blocks.zh: 發現新漏洞或威脅
blocks.en: a new vulnerability or threat is found

blocks.zh: 系統發生重大變更
blocks.en: the system undergoes a major change

blocks.zh: 稽查後有新發現
blocks.en: there are new findings after an inspection

blocks.zh: 風險評估就應重新執行。這與 ICH Q9 的風險管理原則完全一致。
blocks.en: This is fully consistent with the risk management principles of ICH Q9.

blocks.zh: 表格解讀：三個高風險案例
blocks.en: Reading the Table: Three High-Risk Cases

blocks.zh:
1. 存取安全遭破壞（Access security compromised）
高衝擊 + 中可能性，但偵測概率低 → 風險優先級高。這正是為什麼 GxP 系統需要完整的 audit trail——讓偵測概率提升。
blocks.en:
1. Access security compromised
High impact + medium likelihood, but low probability of detection → high risk priority. This is exactly why GxP systems need a complete audit trail: to raise the probability of detection.

blocks.zh:
2. 防火牆設定錯誤（Firewall misconfigured）
高衝擊 + 偵測困難 → 高優先。控制手段：維護正式的 firewall spec + IQ/OQ + Periodic Review。
blocks.en:
2. Firewall misconfigured
High impact + difficult to detect → high priority. Controls: maintain a formal firewall specification + IQ/OQ + periodic review.

blocks.zh:
3. 安裝未授權軟體（Unauthorized software）
高衝擊 + 高可能性 + 低偵測 → 高優先。這是最常見的 IT 風險之一，控制手段需要 Security Procedures + 定期審查。
blocks.en:
3. Unauthorized software installed
High impact + high likelihood + low detection → high priority. This is one of the most common IT risks, and the controls require security procedures + periodic review.

blocks.zh: 比喻：防火牆就是工廠的大門
blocks.en: Analogy: The Firewall Is the Factory Gate

blocks.zh: 防火牆設定錯誤，就像工廠大門沒鎖好——外人可以進入（breach of confidentiality），也可以偷改生產紀錄（unauthorized modifications）。偵測困難（誰進去誰不知道）→ 風險優先級自然高。
blocks.en: A misconfigured firewall is like a factory gate that is not properly locked: outsiders can get in (breach of confidentiality) and can tamper with production records (unauthorized modifications). It is hard to detect (no one knows who went in), so the risk priority is naturally high.

blocks.zh: 解決方案：門要有設計規格（Spec）、安裝後要驗收（IQ/OQ）、定期檢查（Periodic Review）。
blocks.en: The solution: the gate needs a design specification (Spec), acceptance after installation (IQ/OQ), and regular inspection (periodic review).

blocks.zh: 在 Table A2.1 中，「存儲容量上限」的風險優先級為「中」，但如果是 GxP 批次紀錄系統，您認為衝擊應評為多高？
blocks.en: In Table A2.1, the risk priority for "storage capacity limit" is "medium", but for a GxP batch record system, how high do you think the impact should be rated?

blocks.zh: 「未授權軟體安裝」的控制措施是 Security Procedures + Periodic Review，您的組織多久進行一次這類審查？
blocks.en: The controls for "unauthorized software installation" are security procedures + periodic review. How often does your organization perform this kind of review?

blocks.zh: Appendix 3 — Qualification Deliverables 資格確認交付物
blocks.en: Appendix 3 — Qualification Deliverables

blocks.zh: Type vs. Instance：最重要的概念
blocks.en: Type vs. Instance: The Most Important Concept

blocks.zh: Type（類型）資格確認：針對「標準建構模組（Building Block）」的通用規格。例如：「Windows Server 2022 Standard Configuration」的 IQ/OQ——只做一次，適用於所有相同標準配置的伺服器。
blocks.en: Type qualification: covers the generic specification of a "standard building block". For example, the IQ/OQ of a "Windows Server 2022 Standard Configuration" is done only once and applies to all servers with the same standard configuration.

blocks.zh: Instance（實例）資格確認：針對每一台實際部署的伺服器個別執行。僅需做 Instance IQ 和 OQ，並引用 Type 文件作為依據。
blocks.en: Instance qualification: carried out individually for each server actually deployed. Only an Instance IQ and OQ are needed, referencing the Type documents as the basis.

blocks.zh: 這個分層架構的好處：不必為每台伺服器重新做完整資格確認，大大提升效率。
blocks.en: The benefit of this layered structure: there is no need to repeat the full qualification for every server, which greatly improves efficiency.

blocks.zh: 比喻：房屋建設
blocks.en: Analogy: Building Houses

blocks.zh:
Type 資格確認 = 建築師為「標準戶型」審核並核准設計圖（只做一次）
Instance 資格確認 = 工地監工對每棟實際蓋出來的房子做竣工驗收（每棟都要做，但不需要重新審核設計圖）
blocks.en:
Type qualification = the architect reviews and approves the design drawings for a "standard unit type" (done once)
Instance qualification = the site supervisor carries out a completion inspection on each house actually built (required for every house, but the drawings do not need to be reviewed again)

blocks.zh: 設計圖（Type 文件）已通過 QA 批准；每棟房子的施工記錄（Instance 文件）只需 SME 確認，引用設計圖即可。
blocks.en: The drawings (Type documents) have been approved by QA; the construction record for each house (Instance documents) only needs SME confirmation, referencing the drawings.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：QA 在 Instance 層級不需出現
blocks.en: Key Point: QA Is Not Needed at the Instance Level

blocks.zh: 注意表格中的規律：
blocks.en: Note the pattern in the table:

blocks.zh: Type 層級：所有交付物都需要 PO + SME + QA 三方參與
blocks.en: Type level: all deliverables require the participation of PO + SME + QA

blocks.zh: Instance 層級（IQ/OQ/Report）：只需 SME（或 SME + PO），不需要 QA
blocks.en: Instance level (IQ/OQ/Report): only the SME (or SME + PO) is needed, no QA

blocks.zh: 這是效率設計——標準已由 QA 在 Type 層審批，Instance 的個別執行授權 SME 負責，降低 QA 的行政負擔。
blocks.en: This is an efficiency design: the standard has already been approved by QA at the Type level, and individual execution at the Instance level is delegated to the SME, reducing QA's administrative burden.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 新設伺服器
blocks.en: Practical Application: A New Server in a CDMO

blocks.zh: 情境：您的 CDMO 新增第 5 台 LIMS 伺服器，與前 4 台規格相同。
blocks.en: Scenario: your CDMO adds a 5th LIMS server with the same specification as the first 4.

blocks.zh: Type IQ/OQ（第 1 台時完成）：PO + SME + QA 參與 — 已有文件
blocks.en: Type IQ/OQ (completed with the 1st server): PO + SME + QA participated; documents already exist

blocks.zh: 第 5 台 Instance IQ/OQ：SME 執行，引用 Type 文件，不需要 QA 重新審批
blocks.en: 5th server Instance IQ/OQ: executed by the SME, referencing the Type documents, no QA re-approval needed

blocks.zh: Instance Qualification Report：SME + PO 簽署即可
blocks.en: Instance Qualification Report: signed by SME + PO only

blocks.zh: 效率提升顯著——規模擴張時的合規負擔大幅降低。
blocks.en: The efficiency gain is significant: the compliance burden is greatly reduced as the organization scales up.

blocks.zh: 如果一台伺服器的配置與 Type 文件有小差異（例如記憶體規格不同），仍可使用 Instance 流程嗎？
blocks.en: If a server's configuration differs slightly from the Type document (for example, a different memory specification), can the Instance process still be used?

blocks.zh: Table A3.1 中，Client（桌電）的 Instance Qualification Report 由「SME via remote management」負責——這在實務上如何實現？
blocks.en: In Table A3.1, the Instance Qualification Report for a Client (desktop) is the responsibility of the "SME via remote management". How is this achieved in practice?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 附錄 1：8 個關鍵角色各有邊界——Platform Owner 管底層平台，Application Owner 管業務系統，IT Q&C 是技術橋樑，Independent QA 有最終判斷權。無論 IT 委外與否，QA 責任永遠留在受監管公司。
blocks.en: Appendix 1: the 8 key roles each have defined boundaries. The Platform Owner manages the underlying platform, the Application Owner manages the business system, IT Q&C is the technical bridge, and Independent QA has final judgment. Whether or not IT is outsourced, QA responsibility always stays with the regulated company.

blocks.zh: 附錄 2：GAMP 兩階段風險評估——Stage 1（可能性 × 衝擊 → 風險等級），Stage 2（加入偵測概率 → 風險優先級）。風險評估是迭代過程，必須隨系統生命週期持續更新。
blocks.en: Appendix 2: GAMP two-stage risk assessment: Stage 1 (likelihood × impact → risk level), Stage 2 (add probability of detection → risk priority). Risk assessment is an iterative process and must be kept up to date throughout the system life cycle.

blocks.zh: 附錄 3：Type（標準模組）vs. Instance（個別部署）的資格確認分層——Type 層需要 PO + SME + QA 三方，Instance 層只需 SME（+ PO），有效降低規模擴張時的合規負擔。追溯性矩陣確保需求→規格→確認的完整鏈結。
blocks.en: Appendix 3: layered qualification of Type (standard building block) vs. Instance (individual deployment). The Type level requires PO + SME + QA; the Instance level needs only the SME (+ PO), which effectively reduces the compliance burden as the organization scales up. The traceability matrix ensures a complete chain from requirements → specifications → verification.

blocks.zh: 跨附錄主題：IT 基礎架構的合規是「風險驅動」的——從角色分工、風險評估到資格確認的參與深度，都應與所評估的 GxP 風險相稱。
blocks.en: Cross-appendix theme: compliance of IT infrastructure is "risk-driven". From the division of roles to risk assessment to the depth of participation in qualification, everything should be commensurate with the GxP risk being assessed.
